mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,task_id,image_id,producer_invocation,input_id,normalizer_version,snapshot_key,sha256,size,width,height,original_width,original_height,phase,cleanup_state,expires_at FROM task_image_object WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND task_id=#{task} AND image_id=#{image} AND phase='COMMITTED' AND cleanup_state='RETAINED' AND expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
